How do i analyse my soil?

About the calculation

The system uses Halpern or Ges4Seas model to calculate impact in marine areas around the oceans of Denmark.

Map visualisation

Each scenario is a map of Danish waters in 500 × 500 m cells, with a pressure value per cell. The tool subtracts scenario 2's value from scenario 1's, cell by cell. Zero is neutral; a positive cell takes scenario 1's colour, a negative cell scenario 2's. Colour on the map means: here this scenario has more pressure.

Lists data

The numbers in the lists are the same subtraction, summed over all cells per component or zone type. Open a row to see it written out. Percentages are relative to scenario 2, and the arrow says whether pressure rises (red) or falls (green) in scenario 1.
